summary: Sprint E2E PASSED. Backend pytest 51/51 (added 24 new tests covering wallet RBAC, photo CRUD owner-only, admin wallet adjust audit/empty-reason/debit>balance, admin product CRUD). Frontend E2E PASSED for: wallet add money + reload persistence, photo upload + reload persistence, admin wallet adjust dialog (empty reason rejected, credit succeeds + closes), admin product create.

issues: Dialog auto-closes after successful registration so user has to click Account button again to navigate to Wallet/Photos tabs. Minor UX: consider keeping it open and switching to Profile tab.

Amount Input and inner 'Add Money' submit Button lack data-testid attributes — used placeholder/role selectors instead. Recommend adding data-testid='wallet-add-money-open', 'wallet-add-amount-input', 'wallet-add-money-submit' for stable E2E.

action_items: (Nit) Add data-testid attributes to DigitalWallet.js Add Money dialog elements (input + submit) to make UI tests less brittle.
(Nit) After successful register/login, keep Account dialog open and switch to Profile tab so user is not redirected back to home.

(Code quality) AdminPanel.js (950 lines), server.py (1352 lines), and DigitalWallet.js (477 lines) — consider splitting AdminPanel into per-tab subcomponents (UsersTab, ProductsTab, OrdersTab, dialogs/) and server.py into routers (auth, wallet, photos, admin). Both exceed the 700-line threshold.
critical_code_review_comments: verify_user_access correctly returns 403 for both other-user JWT and admin JWT (admin's role != 'user'). Tested and confirmed.

Admin wallet adjust endpoint properly validates empty/whitespace-only reason (400) and debit>balance (400). Audit trail entry includes 'Admin credit: <reason>' or 'Admin debit: <reason>' with category='admin_adjustment'.
Photo upload endpoint correctly requires dimensions (dict) and size (float) fields. Frontend ProfilePhotoStorage.js reads them via FileReader image natural width/height and file size in MB.
Multiple 'Encountered two children with the same key' React warnings in console on home page — likely product listing using non-unique keys. Non-blocking but should be fixed for production.
Console warning 'Using UNSAFE_componentWillMount in strict mode' from a 3rd-party lib (likely react-helmet). Non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all sprint flows verified PASS; product edit/delete UI not retested via Playwright due to card-based DOM, but backend pytest confirms endpoints + buttons render with correct data-testid)

Sprint endpoints fully verified: /api/users/{id}/wallet*, /api/users/{id}/photos*, /api/admin/users/{id}/wallet/adjust, /api/admin/products (POST/PUT/DELETE). (4) The first product card shown ('Updated Product Name 063935') is leftover seed from prior pytest update test - this is expected.
